evidence: Ran the new tests before the fix: `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_app.py -q -k heading` gave 6 failed, 4 passed. The 6 failures were the new tests (phase body, task description and needs-you body, each at the 2 DETAIL_SIZES). The 4 passes were existing tests that also match "heading". After the fix the same command gave 10 passed. Full file with `-n 4`: 196 passed. Tmux tests run serially with `-m tmux -rf`: 11 passed, 370 deselected.
observations: I changed the CSS of TaskDetailScreen, PhaseDetailScreen (#phase-body) and NeedsYouDetailScreen (.needs-panel). The rules are `Markdown > MarkdownBlock { margin: 1 0 0 0; }`, `Markdown > MarkdownHeader { margin: 0; }` and `Markdown > MarkdownBlock:first-child { margin-top: 0; }`. They replace the old `:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }` rule. Spacing choice: I moved the block spacing from bottom margins to top margins. Removing only the heading top margin is not enough. Textual's paragraph, list, table and fence blocks have default bottom margins, and those still leave a blank line above the next heading. Textual CSS has no sibling selector, so I cannot target "the block before a heading". With top margins, every block except a heading has one blank line above it. Paragraph-to-paragraph spacing and the blank line between a heading and its text stay as they were. The first block sits on the first line of the panel, and no blank line remains at the bottom. The tests are in tests/test_dashboard_app.py: test_phase_body_headings_have_no_blank_line_above, test_task_description_headings_have_no_blank_line_above and test_needs_you_body_headings_have_no_blank_line_above. They share a helper and a HEADED_BODY source (H2, H3, a paragraph and a list). The helper checks widget regions: the first block starts at the top of the Markdown, and the row above each heading belongs to the previous block. The test file imports MarkdownHeader from textual.widgets._markdown, because textual.widgets.markdown does not export it. The diff touches only the Markdown lines in the three CSS blocks and the new tests. Commit is in the worktree on wt/heading-spacing, not pushed.
